summary: Enhance your skills in healthcare analytics and data management with our comprehensive training course. Gain insights and expertise to excel in the industry.
lede: Healthcare analytics uses clinical and operational data to support patient-care and service decisions. For analysts, informatics managers, quality teams, and healthcare IT professionals, this course addresses the practical task of turning fragmented records into usable analysis through SQL data extraction, cross-system mapping, and clinical performance dashboard design.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with managing, analyzing, or governing health-related data to improve institutional performance.
modules: Health Informatics Foundations and Data Architecture
Clinical Analytics and Population Health Management
Operational Analytics and Healthcare Performance Metrics
Healthcare Data Governance and Privacy Compliance
Visual Analytics and Clinical Decision Support
Strategic Integration and Future Health Technology
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of healthcare operations or clinical workflows. Familiarity with spreadsheet software (Excel) is required. No prior programming or SQL experience is necessary, as foundational concepts will be covered during the course.
